A '''piglin''' in [[Matcha Flavoured]] barters from a changed list of items, ignores players wearing [[Adamant equipment|adamant]] or [[Electrum equipment|electrum]] armor as it would gold, and no longer cares about bells. Piglin brutes drop {{ItemLink|Divine Fragment|divine fragments}} and {{ItemLink|Adamant Scrap}}.

== Bartering ==
{{Data/Loot/minecraft/gameplay/piglin_bartering}}
Compared to vanilla, the bartering table no longer gives iron boots or potions, and Soul Speed books are twice as likely (weight 10 instead of 5).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/piglin_bartering.json}}</ref> Several items appear under their pack names: ender pearls are {{ItemLink|Stable Void|stable voids}}, leather is {{ItemLink|Sturdy Leather}}, nether bricks are {{ItemLink|Hellbrick|hellbricks}} and nether quartz is {{ItemLink|Quartz}}.

== Behavior ==
=== Armor ===
The pack adds the four netherite armor pieces to the <code>#minecraft:piglin_safe_armor</code> tag.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/item/piglin_safe_armor.json}}</ref> Adamant armor is netherite armor renamed, and electrum armor is built on netherite armor items, so wearing either keeps piglins calm like golden armor.

=== Loved items ===
Piglins are attracted to the same gold items as in vanilla, except bells, which the pack removes from the <code>#minecraft:piglin_loved</code> tag.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/item/piglin_loved.json}}</ref>

== Piglin brute ==
Piglin brutes have their own loot table in the pack. When killed by a player, a brute drops:<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/entities/piglin_brute.json}}</ref>
* a {{ItemLink|Divine Fragment}} with a 15% chance, raised to 25% with Looting I and by 10% per further level;
* {{ItemLink|Adamant Scrap}} with a 30% chance, raised to 35% with Looting I and by 5% per further level.
{{Data/Loot/minecraft/entities/piglin_brute}}
